deadline.value: No single 2027 date is published; the application deadline is set by each funded project advert.
deadline.quote: Please note the application deadlines on each funded project advert, as these may vary.

gre_subject.value: King's does not consider the GRE in its selection processes, so no GRE Subject test is used.
gre_subject.quote: Please note that at King's we do not consider the GRE in our selection processes.

supervisor.value: Written agreement from a supervisor is needed before the application can go forward.
supervisor.quote: You must receive written confirmation that your supervisor(s) have agreed to submit you before progressing with your application.

also.quote: Prospective students are encouraged to explore potential supervisors and their research areas.

funding.value: All scholarships and awards are competitive; some cover both stipend and fees, others fees only.
funding.quote: All scholarships, bursaries or other awards are offered on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree with 2:1 honours in a related subject; a 2:2 is considered only with a Chemistry master's with Merit or above.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should hold a bachelor's degree with 2:1 honours in a related subject.

notes: The department page lists Oct, Feb and June entry with funded and self-funded deadlines, but gives no 2027 date.
